scope: Independent full rebuild from one portable snapshot. This temporary directory is not the final release ZIP. Documentation, validation reports and browser artifacts may be finalized after this snapshot; final release byte verification is separate. Assertions here cover both executed core scripts, all listed build inputs, all15 font bytes and charset. No raw TTC, previous archive, source repository parent layout or browser is needed for this rebuild/generic validation. This does not establish all-size pixel identity or per-character optical acceptance.

baseline_source_scope.description: The Source Han comparison font covers genuine source glyphs only. Declared original symbols are excluded solely from this comparison font; every final OTF, TTF and WOFF2 is still checked against the full charset.

manifest.origin: Original geometric outlines created for Aincrad UI SC, 2026; no font outlines extracted from Unicode charts or SAOUI.
